en: "Well...{w}I had to... fight... so..."{w}{p}"Besides, in front of you lot, I wouldn't look the part if I didn't talk like that, would I?"{w}
note: Japanese full-width indent after {w} dropped. 'talk like that' = her earlier archaic, imperious speech (we/thou register in 1064-1069). Editorial: reordered the stacked clauses of page 2 ('facing you lot, if I didn't..., I wouldn't...') for spoken flow; meaning unchanged.

en: "What do you mean, 'is that really so'?"{w}
note: Echoes Zeshrom's 1098 'Is that really so?' so the quote lands.

en: "I simply cannot believe that they wish for your return."{w}

"...What are you saying?
Quit making such nasty accusations."{w}{p}"These kids went to the trouble of tracking down my name, and they called me by it, just like this!"{w}
"Of course they're happy I came back!{w}Riiight?"{w}
note: Source ends with a music note (singsong); rendered as drawn-out 'Riiight?' since ASCII only.

en: "You're happy I came back, right?{w}I mean... I... um...{w}
note: No closing quote, as in the source; the line is redrawn and completed by 1114.
The {0E}...{0F} span must repeat 1112 word for word (redraw of the previous text); the \n breaks mirror where 1112's {w} breaks fall.

en: "Look at what they hold in their hands.{w}They are gathering divine relics for Fiona, so that this land never passes to you, you see."{w}{p}"Well, from their point of view..."{w}{p}"they could hardly bear to lose everything they have built up to this day to an upheaval as vast as one land replacing another."{w}
note: 'Daichi no koutai' rendered as 'the land being replaced' (Urna's land replacing Fiona's). Page 2 ends mid-sentence and page 3 continues it, as in the source. Editorial: 'in an upheaval as great as the land being replaced' -> 'to an upheaval as vast as one land replacing another' (idiomatic 'lose X to Y'; clearer that Urna's land would replace Fiona's, cf. 'Fiona's land' 1124). Accuracy recheck requested.

en:
"Why are they searching for the divine relics?
You said it yourself, did you not?"{w}
"The reason these kids... are gathering the relics?{w}The reason is... um...{w}to protect... Fiona's... sovereignty..."{w}

"When they first settled in this land, I suppose they truly meant, in their own way, to keep their vow to you. I won't deny that much. However..."{w}{p}"As time went by and they learned they could get along just fine in Fiona's land, they chose the Fiona they had grown used to over waiting for your return."{w}{p}"With each new generation, that inconvenient vow from the past was buried deeper in the dust."{w}
"As far as they are concerned, the land need only be there. 'Who' that land is means nothing to such short lives."{w}
note: 'Who' in single quotes for the source's double-bracket emphasis: the land is a person (its goddess).

en: "Your awakening is just a troublesome affair that disturbs the peace--nothing but a nuisance to them.{w}No one wants you back at all!"{w}

note: Subject of 'called my name' is unstated; read as addressed to the party ('you'), as in 1081 and 1112 where she pleads with them directly. Could also be 'they'.

'I... for your sake... even my life...' kept as a deliberate trail-off (verb unsaid in the source). 'Sarijana-sama' honorific dropped: glossary gender for Sarijana is unknown, so no Lord/Lady. 'Father' = o-tousama, identity not stated here.

en: "We shall make a place for you to belong.{w}Espel-Dex will... no, I{w}will guarantee your future, and I shall never betray you."{w}
note: Cut at the {w} after 'I' matches the source's self-correction. Editorial: 'promise you your future' -> 'guarantee your future' (awkward double object).

en: "Please wait--before we return, the divine relics..."{w}
"If they want them, let them have them."{w}

"You need eight divine relics to gain sovereignty over the land?{w}Hah! What rubbish!!"{w}{p}"That was only ever something Dehain decided.
I just played along with that little game!"{w}

"Wha--!? N-no, but...
without the divine relics, carving your name into Contrachio is..."{w}

note: Zefkaka used as a role ('the Zefkaka') per glossary note. 'this lot' = koitsura (rude), the party.

en:
"If you choose Fiona, then you're my enemies now, too.
Come to Contrachio, if you dare!!"{w}{p}"I'll destroy you along with this whole land!{w}I won't save you anymore! I'll slaughter every last one of you!!{w}This time, I'm going to win, no matter what!!"{w}
note: Proof (accuracy recheck requested by editorial): restored 'too' for the source's mo (you too, like Fiona, are enemies).

en: "Even ingratitude has its limits!{w}You are no longer worth letting live!"{w}{p}"I shall bury you with my own hands, so go on and perish, cursing yourselves for choosing Fiona!!"{w}
note: Speaker '???' is Urna's imperious voice (same opening as 1072) on the branch where the party does not name her; archaic register kept. Editorial: same source phrase as 1072 (slice 006, 'Even ingratitude has its lim--?!', cut off there); now completed with the same wording so the recurring line matches.

en: "Damn it...{w}You'll pay for this... all of you, I swear..."{w}

Glaring at you with eyes full of hatred,
Urna departed.{w}

"I have come to take not only that divine relic,
but every divine relic you possess.{w}Now, be good and hand them all over!"{w}
"So you won't hand them over, no matter what.{w}Then come to Contrachio.{w}{p}"My powerful subordinates will be sure to show you some hospitality."{w}
note: Speaker field says Zeshrom (key 1182, presumably a repeated Zeshrom name box, is missing as a duplicate), so the demon of 1179-1181 is Zeshrom. The source's first quote is never closed before the second opens; mirrored as is.

en: "Settling a battle of wits with brute force...{w}How crude of you lot."{w}
note: Source typo 'shiyou' written with the wrong kanji (private use); read as 'trying to settle'.
Insert is presumably the relic name from the list 1190-1197 (no article in those names, hence 'the').
New name. Follows the glossary pattern of Earring of Vengeance (piasu = pierced earring).
Insert is presumably an altar name from 1205-1210, hence 'prayed at the'. If the insert turns out to be a god name, change to 'You prayed to {0C:0003:0010}.'
Same assumption as 1201.
Classic Wizardry term for a rotating floor tile. Alternative: 'Rotating Floor'.

Source begins with a black square marker (non-ASCII), replaced by '*'. These two op0fb rows look like script branch labels (with / without the light spell) and may never be shown; check before shipping.
kaijou = unlocking (by key or picking); kept neutral as 'unlock'.
